about: Vectors for window-lease/1 (DEC-0062). verify: verifyWindowLease(lease, trust) with trust.at an RFC 3339 string a port parses strictly (an unparseable one is an unreadable clock) and trust.estateRecord, when absent, the estateRecord below: the members of fixtures/positive/estate-record-first.json the verifier reads. reserve: mayReserve(lease, request), the meter's decision under a verified lease. remainder: windowRemainder(ledger), the hub's division; a report's receivedAt is its own at (DEC-0132 MR-5), never its delivery; a machine's reports are ordered by it to the nanosecond (DEC-0146 MR-1), a tie going to the larger spent. decimals: usdMicros; periods: periodBounds and periodOf. The hub key's seed is the test key of fixtures/vectors/estate-record.json (keys.hub); Ed25519 is deterministic, so a port's signer reproduces every sig. Never real credentials.
